scope: Synthetic CPU only; production disabled; no gen38, historical experiment, workers, training or merge
notes: The two 10k timing runs preceded caller eviction-owner rotation and final optional memory/cache probes. Policy none has no active compact payloads. The no-export run used unchanged PR74; the full-export run used the isolated gate adapter. Core Anemone sources are exactly the same in every case.
Final 1k cases use the final adapter, sequential fresh processes, 128 cache entries normally and 8 for cache-bound. Object probes are intrusive and excluded from speed comparisons.
RSS peak is process-lifetime ru_maxrss, not a stage-local peak. Tracked-object snapshots are samples, not an exact allocation high water mark. No population-scale throughput/memory claim is made.
